7043.title: Churn Drivers: Offers and Network Issues
7043.description: This cluster represents customers who churn due to competitive offers, network reliability, and perceived extra data or long-distance charges. Retention efforts should focus on value proposition and service stability.

7044.title: DSL Internet and No Phone Service
7044.description: Customers in this cluster primarily use DSL internet and lack phone service or multiple lines. Focus on upselling or ensuring satisfaction with their current DSL setup to improve retention.

7045.title: No Internet Services, Mailed Check Payments
7045.description: This group lacks various internet-dependent services and prefers mailed check payments. Retention strategies could involve highlighting the benefits of internet services and offering more convenient payment options.

7046.title: No Services, No Churn Reasons
7046.description: These customers do not utilize phone, internet, or related services and have no specific churn reasons. Retention may focus on proactive engagement and ensuring basic needs are met without issue.
